programs.title: Cruise Ship Killers
programs.desc: A farmer and his wife take a cruise celebrating their hard work and good fortune, but their luck changes drastically and the friends who are on board celebrating with them now aid in the search for the farmer who is now missing at sea.

programs.title: Almost Unsolved Heists
programs.desc: After a series of security lapses, Wells Fargo had over $7 Million stolen in one night in a heist dubbed White Eagle; bizarrely, it was pulled of by a revolutionary guerrilla group from Puerto Rico.

programs.title: Charmed to Death
programs.desc: Shawnie meets Ron online and the romance develops over a shared love of athletics; Shawnie moves to the mountains to be with Ron, but when his erratic behavior turns from manipulative to criminal, she must confront Ron's secret life.

programs.title: Heartland Homicide
programs.desc: A family man goes missing in a small West Virginian town known for its sweet mountain air.

programs.title: Birdeater
programs.desc: A bride-to-be joins her own fiancé's bachelor party in the remote Australian Outback. As the festivities spiral into beer-soaked chaos, uncomfortable details about their relationship are exposed, turning the celebration into a feral nightmare.

programs.title: Some Other Woman
programs.desc: Eve sees a strange woman watching her and her husband from outside their home. As the stranger slowly intrudes further into their lives, Eve begins to question if she's losing her mind or her husband's loyalty.
